metadata.title: Constant mixed Chern curvature on complete type-A flag manifolds
metadata.abstract: We prove that the complete flag manifold SU(m)/T m-1, with m >= 3 and its standard complex structure, admits no invariant Hermitian metric with constant mixed Chern curvature when the coefficient of the holomorphic sectional curvature is nonzero. This extends the preceding nonexistence result for a particular Wallach metric on SU(3)/T2 to all invariant Hermitian metrics and to complete type-A flags of arbitrary dimension. Curvature evaluations on holomorphic root spheres contradict a necessary trace identity, covering both Kahler and non-Kahler invariant metrics and excluding both zero and nonzero curvature constants.

analysis.workSummary: 证明标准复结构的完全 A 型旗流形 SU(m)/T^{m−1}（m≥3）上，不存在全纯截面曲率系数非零且混合 Chern 曲率为常数的不变 Hermitian 度量。
analysis.breakthrough: 将一个特定 Wallach 度量的障碍推广到任意维完全 A 型旗流形的所有不变度量。
analysis.limitations: 结论限于不变度量与指定非零系数，不是否定所有 Hermitian 度量。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 对齐性复几何中的常曲率存在问题提供统一排除机制。
